design_decisions.decision: No __init__.py/conftest.py: tests sys.path.insert backend/ and import flat modules; rejected a package layout (would need __init__.py and relative imports).
Read form manually via request.form() in the route instead of FastAPI File()/Form() params, so 413/422/500 and precedence are controlled in one place.
Precedence: body limit 413 > shape 422 > photo-size 413 > content 422 > 500. Mismatched extension/content accepted if real format allowed; stored extension follows real format.
Streamed body limit enforced by raising HTTPException(413) from wrapped receive; rejected a custom exception since ServerErrorMiddleware would turn it into 500.
DB/uploads created in lifespan, not at import, so importing main in tests never touches the real DB; default DB is logs.db at project root (created only on real run).
Photo paths stored/returned as "uploads/ID.ext" regardless of the configured dir, so tests can redirect storage.

implementation.self_critique: Weakest: concurrency (distinct filenames) only argued via uuid4 and open mode "xb", not tested concurrently. Default DB name logs.db is my choice (.gitignore is empty so it is not ignored). Streamed-limit test uses a tiny custom limit rather than 26 MiB chunked.
